events.title: Taiwanese Waves 10th Anniversary: 9m88 + ØZI + YELLOW / Chance Emerson / Mong Tong / Chinatown Records
events.description:
Want to see the show from the best seats in the house? Try becoming a  SummerStage Member for a Day ! Enjoy skip-the-line, complimentary drinks, and air-conditioned restrooms. 
   
 Taiwanese Waves is celebrating its 10th anniversary by showcasing a diverse lineup of artists from across the musical spectrum. This year’s program includes a trio of R&B and hip-hop acts: 9m88 (pronounced “Jo-m-Baba”), a jazzy singer-songwriter with strong R&B, neo-soul, and hip-hop influences; ØZI, a singer-songwriter and rapper known for blending urban American styles with Mandopop; and YELLOW 黃宣, the fashion-forward avant pop artist with a flair for the dramatic. You’re likely to hear some of their collaborations, such as ØZI and 9m88’s song “Black Out,” or the 9m88 and YELLOW (黃宣) single “怪天氣Strange Weather.” They’re joined by Chance Emerson, a relative of Ralph Waldo Emerson born in Taiwan to a Taiwanese mother and American father and a singer-songwriter who explores the human condition with humor and empathy; Mong Tong, Taiwanese brothers who channel Southeast Asian mythology and folklore through the hypnotic rhythms and ethereal melodies of ‘60s and ‘70s psychedelic music; and a DJ set from Chinatown Records, the archival project from DJ and historian yiuyiu 瑶瑶 that stewards more than 30 distinct vinyl, CD, and cassette collections inherited from her family & neighbors, spanning nearly 100 years of Chinese music and beyond.

events.title: Chance the Rapper: Coloring Book 10 Year Anniversary Tour / La Reezy
events.description:
SummerStage Member  Presale:  Wednesday, May 20 at 10AM  
  Capital One Cardholder  Presale:  Wednesday, May 20 at 10AM  
 General on-sale:  Thursday, May 21 at 10AM  
 The show will celebrate the ten year anniversary of his seminal, acclaimed mixtape  Coloring Book , which redefined the gospel-rap genre and was the soundtrack to a generation’s college years with songs like “All Night” and “All We Got”. The award-winning artist, visionary, and community builder made history as the first independent artist to win a GRAMMY with the project, taking home the Best New Artist and Best Rap Album awards.   Hailed as “one of the best rap albums” of 2016 by  Pitchfork , it featured an all-star roster of collaborators including Noname, T-Pain, Anderson .Paak, 2 Chains, and Justin Bieber. La Reezy will open.

events.title: SIMPLE PLAN / 3OH!3 / BOWLING FOR SOUP

SummerStage Member  Presale:  Thursday, February 12 at 10AM  
  Capital One Cardholder  Presale:  Tuesday, February 10 at 12PM

  Simple Plan’s tour is a veritable who’s who of 2000’s rock, headlined by the “I’m Just a Kid” and “Perfect” hitmakers who’ve been cranking out top-of-the-charts songs for more than 25 years. They’re joined by club anthem extraordinaires 3OH!3, behind songs like “DONTTRUSTME” and “My First Kiss”, the latter of which features pop princess Kesha.  Bowling for Soup, of “1985” and “High School Never Ends” fame, will also perform for a night filled with hits from your high school CD mixtape.

events.title: Angélique Kidjo / Cimafunk / DJ Freshy K
events.description: Beninese singer Angélique Kidjo returns to SummerStage with her multilingual fusion of Afrobeat, pop, jazz, reggae, and various African traditions and percussive rhythms that earned her international acclaim. After arriving in Paris in the early ‘90s, Kidjo recorded a run of critically acclaimed albums on Island Records—beginning with the chart-topping 1991 album  Logozo —and followed it up with an ambitious trilogy exploring African music’s influence in the Americas, from gospel to Brazilian and Latin. Over her multi-decade career she’s collaborated with the likes of Philip Glass and the Kronos Quartet to Peter Gabriel, Alicia Keys, Dr. John, and Branford Marsalis. Her latest album,  Hope!!  is dedicated to her late mother, and features contributions from Pharrell Williams, Nile Rodgers, Ayra Starr, Quavo, and The Gap Band’s Charlie Wilson. DJ Freshy K, a Nigerian Afrobeats specialist based in NYC who has opened for the likes of Jidenna, Flavour, Olamide, Davido, and Wizkid, opens the show with a DJ set.

events.title: Myles Smith: My Mess, My Heart, My Life Tour with Special Guest Michael Marcagi
events.description:
SummerStage Member  Presale:  Wednesday, March 25 at 12PM  
  Capital One Cardholder  Presale:  Wednesday, March 25 at 12PM  
 General on-sale:  Friday, March 27 at 10AM  
  Luton-born Myles Smith has been playing music since he was 12 years old, performing at open mic nights in local pubs. Since then, fans around the world have gone wild for his folksy pop sound and emotional lyrics. His breakthrough single “Stargazing” amassed more than a billion streams when it was released in 2024, leading to his 2025 wins of the    BRITs    Rising Star Award and    BBC Introducing    Artist of the Year. In addition to his solo My Mess, My Heart, My Life tour, he’ll be supporting Ed Sheeran on the North American leg of his Loop Tour in 2026. Folk-rock singer and songwriter Michael Marcagi will open the evening.

events.title: Samara Joy and Christian McBride Celebrate Verve’s 70th Anniversary / Mei Semones & Friends play the music of Getz/Gilberto / Sparklmami DJ set
events.description: Performers for this celebration of the label’s 70th anniversary include Samara Joy, a six-time GRAMMY winner and Bronx native, and Christian McBride, a world-class bassist and bandleader, a Juilliard graduate and 11-time GRAMMY winner who has recorded with legends of both the jazz (McCoy Tyner, Herbie Hancock, Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, Eddie Palmieri, and more) and pop (Sting, Paul McCartney, Celine Dion) spheres. Also, Mei Semones, an American indie rock musician who writes jazz-influenced songs in both English and Japanese, has invited her own crew of friends including aron!, Liana Flores, and John Roseboro to perform music from Getz/Gilberto, the classic collaborative album by João Gilberto and Stan Getz released on Verve in 1964. Sparklmami will begin the show with a DJ set.

events.title: Darling Blue PT2 Tour: Marcus King Band / Penelope Road
events.description:
SummerStage Member  Presale:  Thursday, March 12 at 10AM  
 Capital One Cardholder  Presale:  Wednesday, March 11 at 10AM  
General on-sale:  Friday, March 13 at 10AM  
 GRAMMY-nominated country artist Marcus King is hitting the road with his longtime live band on the Darling Blue PT2 Tour, a reunion eight years in the making. His upcoming album,  Darling   Blue , features a who’s who of country music such as Billy Strings and Kaitlin Butts.  His twangy, guitar-heavy songs like “Wildflowers and Wine” and “Homesick” tend to be love letters offering appreciation for his home state of South Carolina and his southern roots. Atlanta-born band Penelope Road will open the evening.

events.title: Young Thug: The New Generation Tour with NAV

  Capital One Cardholder Presale:  Wednesday, July 15 at 12PM

events.title: Danny Elfman
events.description:
Capital One Presale: Wednesday, July 8 at 12PM 
 SummerStage Member Presale: Thursday, July 9 at 10AM. 
 General onsale: Friday, July 10 at 10AM. 
 The internationally acclaimed film and classical composer has enjoyed a longstanding partnership with Tim Burton, scoring films like  Edward Scissorhands  and  Pee-wee’s Big Adventure . More recently, he’s returned to his legendary rock roots (formerly of new wave icon Oingo Boingo) with his album  Big   Mess  and his forthcoming fall album, which he will bring to SummerStage.

events.title: (RESCHEDULED) New York Sings Yiddish: Passing the Torch to a New Generation Featuring The Shvesters / YidLife Crisis / Yair Keydar / Riki Rose + More
events.description:
IMPORTANT UPDATE: Due to the threat of severe weather, New York Sings Yiddish has been rescheduled from Monday, June 22 to Thursday, September 17 at 7 PM.  
  While we’re disappointed not to gather with you tomorrow evening, the good news is that we’ll still be celebrating together this fall with an unforgettable night of Yiddish music under the stars at SummerStage in Central Park.  
  We look forward to seeing you on September 17!  
   
 The National Yiddish Theatre Folksbiene returns to Central Park with a bold, joyful lineup of emerging talent and distinctive voices. Musical director Zalmen Mlotek leads a fresh wave of artists shaping the sound of today. Mlotek is a conductor, pianist, musical arranger, accompanist, composer, and the Artistic Director of the NYTF, the longest continuously running Yiddish theatre in the world. 
 The performance features an exciting roster of rising stars, including Yair Keydar, the 13-year-old Star Search veteran; Yosef Kogan, the 13-year-old violin prodigy who has performed at Carnegie Hall, Merkin Hall, and the Prague String Festival; The Mamales, a dynamic trio of young women singers who met while performing  Fiddler on the Roof  in Yiddish; Riki Rose, a Yiddish singer, songwriter, comedian from Williamsburg’s Satmar community; Margot Weintraub, the young actress and singer best known for roles in the Amazon series  Hunters  and Sarah Silverman’s Off-Broadway show  The Bedwetter ; and special guests The Shvesters, a dazzling and distinctive duo that transform classic Yiddish melodies into new jazz arrangements. Serving as masters of ceremony are the stars of the Canadian web series YidLife Crisis, collaborating with Frank London’s Klezmer All Stars, a brass group that blends Yiddish, Hasidic music, and Klezmer with electronic beats.

events.title: RESCHEDULED: SOLD OUT: Yeat: The LOVE/LYFE Tour / Glokk40Spaz
events.description:
This show has been rescheduled to Friday, September 18.   
 Yeat’s latest album  ADL (A Dangerous Lyfe / A Dangerous Love ), released just this past Friday, features an all-star list of collaborators ranging from Elton John to 070 Shake to Grimes, showcasing his talent for bringing together unique sounds and pushing the boundaries of his genre. Since 2018, he has gained a huge social media following and a loyal Gen Z fanbase in the process. Glokk40Spaz will support the evening.

events.title: Of Monsters and Men / August Ponthier
events.description: The Icelandic indie band broke onto the scene in 2011 with their hit “Little Talks,” which led to more than a billion Spotify streams and a    Saturday Night Live    performance. Since then, they’ve run the gamut of performance from cameos on    HBO   ’s    Game of Thrones    to sets at Coachella, Glastonbury, and Lollapalooza. After some time pursuing solo projects, they’re reuniting for The Mouse Parade Tour, named for their most recent 2025 album. Indie singer songwriter August Ponthier will open the evening.

events.title: The Age of the Ram Tour: Charley Crockett with special guests Durand Jones and the Indications
events.description:
SummerStage Member  Presale:  Thursday, March 5 at 12PM  
  Capital One Cardholder  Presale:  Tuesday, March 3 at 11AM   
 General on-sale:  Friday, March 6 at 10AM  
 “Street busker turned critically acclaimed singer-songwriter turned actual country star” ( Rolling   Stone ), Charley Crockett’s particular brand of country has earned him millions of streams and several GRAMMY nominations. His deep voice and Americana style on songs like “Lonesome Drifter” and “I’m Just a Clown” evoke a version of the country filled with tumbleweeds and cowboys. He’s played across the U.S. at venues including Red Rocks, the Hollywood Bowl, and even SummerStage in 2022, when he opened for Willie Nelson. Durand Jones and the Indications will open the evening. 
  Charley Crockett, in partnership with PLUS1, will contribute $1.00 from every ticket sold to Last Prisoner Project.

events.title: Odd Mob
events.description:
Due to Friday’s extreme heat threat (temps expected over 100°), the Odd Mob performance in Central Park on 7/3 has been rescheduled to 5/29/2027 . More information can be found at your point of purchase.  
  Known for his genre-defying approach, Australian producer and DJ   Odd Mob   has cemented his place at the forefront of global electronic music. He broke through with the 2014 hit ‘Is It A Banger’; since then, Odd Mob has released a string of hits like ‘LEFT TO RIGHT,’ ‘Get Busy,’ and many more, pushing him past 400+ million streams across platforms. 2026 is looking to be his biggest year yet with a string of new releases and shows across the U.S.A, Asia, Europe, the U.K., and in his home region of Australia.
